hero.subtitle: Jaroslav Pavelka's goalie camp at Kapka resort Vsetín. Ice, dryland, video analysis and training with top coaches.

about.paragraph1: Jaroslav Pavelka is a professional goaltender with more than 15 years on the ice. He came up through the Canadian OHL juniors (Niagara IceDogs, Windsor Spitfires), represented the Czech Republic from U16 to U18 and has logged over 90 games in the Extraliga.
about.paragraph2: At the camp he passes on what he has spent years refining at the highest level – from technique to reading the game.
about.quote: When I was starting out, I didn't have a coach who fully focused on goalies. <red>Pavelka 31 Kemp is the answer.</red>

rules.title: General camp rules
rules.body: Open to ages 8 and up; a parent / legal guardian signs the participation agreement. Training follows the daily schedule, which you'll receive by email 14 days before the camp. Arrive 30 minutes before the first session and leave after the video analysis. Supervision is provided throughout the camp. Participants follow the coaching team's instructions and behave considerately toward others.

rules.title: Required equipment
rules.body: Complete goalie gear in good working condition (a helmet with a functional cage is mandatory!), 2× stick, 2× shirt, towel, water bottle (min. 1 L), a snack for each day, toiletries. We recommend bringing your own mask. A drying room is available at the arena, but a second set of gear helps. Stick tape, electrical tape and minor repairs are on us.

rules.title: Cancellation terms
rules.body: Cancellation more than 30 days before the camp starts: 100% refund with no cancellation fee. 30–14 days: 50% of the paid amount refunded. Less than 14 days: no refund, but you may find your own replacement (same age category). For medical reasons with a doctor's note we refund 80% regardless of the cancellation date.

rules.title: Medical fitness
rules.body: On arrival, the parent / legal guardian submits a signed declaration of the child's medical fitness (we'll send the form by email). List all allergies, chronic conditions and any medication taken. Participation is not possible with an acute illness (fever, infection). A medic is available at the camp; more serious injuries are handled with the parent and the local emergency service.

rules.title: GDPR and photo consent
rules.body: By registering you consent to the processing of personal data for the purpose of organizing the camp, keeping participant records, payments and communication. You agree to photographs and video being taken during training and used in the camp's promotional materials (website, Instagram, Facebook). You can decline photography in the note field during registration. Consent can be withdrawn at any time by email at info@pavelka31kemp.cz.

rules.title: Insurance
rules.body: The camp carries third-party liability insurance. Participants must have their own health insurance (insurance card) and we recommend accident insurance. Damage to gear entrusted by the arena is the responsibility of the parent / legal guardian. The camp is not liable for personal belongings lost in the changing room.
